tests.name: companion messages stay disabled on staging (read-only GET, no member data)

tests.reason: The change is the companion tick's bulk enrichment reads and the eligible-card set on MemberContext. The tick never runs on staging (the engine answers disabled-on-staging, staging shares the production database, rule 48), so the behaviour is proven offline: vtid-05367 pins false-initialized completion for a member with no rows, the per-member rules (inactive/disconnected social, disabled calendar, revoked tokens do not count), dismissal rows grouped per member, a failing source reported in enrichment_unavailable without throwing (one and all sources down), E6/E7 hidden while the Meta OAuth client is unset and shown when set, and an E8 dismissal hidden at +3 days and back at +8 days (the tick's real now). The existing companion suites prove nothing else changed.
